title: Positive octahedra and primitive fillings for trees of crossing circles
status: Draft; classical marked all-circle tree completion under sqrt(d_v^2+n_v^2)>=630, with absolute metric volume and a heterogeneous-radius alternative
imports: Only the local peripheral-volume differential for an oriented positive ideal chain from Circle patterns and primitive fillings of augmented links, Section 7, equation (7.3).

The ordered cut, positive blocks, primitive winding, cone completion and same-chain absolute-volume comparison are proved here. The paper does not import a quantum asymptotic or the companion long-filling existence theorem; moving-meridian and nonparabolic longitude adapters remain separate.
scope: Typesetting, page count and declared imports only; not proof verification.
